mapper.insert: insert into book(book_name, author, price, stock, category_id) values(#{bookName}, #{author}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{categoryId})
mapper.update: update book set stock = stock - #{num} where id = #{id} and stock >= #{num}
mapper.select: select b.id,b.book_name,b.author,b.price,b.stock,b.category_id,c.category_name from book b left join category c on b.category_id = c.id

select b.id,b.book_name,b.author,b.price,b.stock,b.category_id,c.category_name from book b left join category c on b.category_id = c.id where b.book_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.author like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')

select b.id,b.book_name,b.author,b.price,b.stock,b.category_id,c.category_name, coalesce(sum(o.buy_num),0) as sales from book b left join category c on b.category_id = c.id left join orders o on o.book_id = b.id group by b.id,b.book_name,b.author,b.price,b.stock,b.category_id,c.category_name order by sales desc limit #{limit}

select b.id,b.book_name,b.author,b.price,b.stock,b.category_id,c.category_name, coalesce(sum(o.buy_num),0) as sales from book b left join category c on b.category_id = c.id left join orders o on o.book_id = b.id
